The evidence is supported by a moderate confidence score (0.5363), suggesting that while there is a plausible mechanism, further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Isoglochidiolide and Phosphodiesterase 6C. The mechanism involves a cascade of molecular interactions, highlighting the complexity of drug-target relationships in biological systems.
